Overview

This feature service provides bike lane information for Westbank First Nation (WFN), supporting the mapping and management of current and proposed cycling infrastructure within the community.

Feature Layer

  • Bike Lanes — A line feature layer representing bike lane routes and related trail segments. It includes descriptive attributes such as lane name, location, ownership, trail type, current or future status, roadway context, speed limit, lane count, and notes to support planning and reference.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation (WFN) lands in the Central Okanagan region of British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Cycling and active transportation planning
  • Public information and route reference
  • Infrastructure inventory and maintenance support
  • Transportation and recreation mapping

Source and Licensing

Owned and maintained by Westbank First Nation (WFN), the content is made available under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and related terms of use.
